note: HH_260906 - Keep local code-regression evidence separate from remote model learning and vehicle qualification.

main.command: source scripts/e2e/env.sh && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 python3 -m pytest -q -rs -p no:cacheprovider tests

launch.command: source scripts/e2e/env.sh && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 python3 -m pytest -q -rs -p no:cacheprovider autoware_e2e_vad_launch/test

skip_reasons.reason: Existing local Torch lacks secure torch.load(weights_only=...) required by the tests.
Pinned Woraksan route/map bundle is not available.

limits: These are local CPU code checks, not remote training completion or actual Autoware/CARLA driving.
Focused runner, model, summary and renderer checks are included in the full main suite, not additional independent test counts.
The remote worker remains on its distinct fixed training commit; local summary and plot development does not edit the active remote source.
External packages, weights and the entire dataset are not covered by the declared repository source snapshot.
Observation timestamps are not exact process-exit timestamps; use pytest-reported durations.
